claim: Near/far propagation slopes need a fixed 10m breakpoint instead of one slope
evidence_before: Device offsets improve only 0.89%, below acceptance threshold; same-model identity alone does not explain remaining errors
mechanism: Two continuous distance slopes with receiver intercepts, use dB-Huber to avoid an ambiguous analytic inverse
failure_mode: NLOS is spatial, not solely distance-dependent; near/far fit may fail on unseen rooms
ablation_reference: Compare both incumbent Cauchy and r2 dB-Huber; cannot isolate slope effect from incumbent comparison alone
